### [`v0.35.1`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.35.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/compare/v0.35.0...v0.35.1)

buildkit 0.35.1

Welcome to the v0.35.1 release of buildkit!

Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
<https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues>.

##### Contributors

- CrazyMax
- Tõnis Tiigi

##### Notable Changes

- Make sure empty attestation manifests are skipped [#​7419](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/7419)
- Allow sharing snapshot key names with `docker pull` as was allowed before v0.33.x
- Fix regression where large filesync pattern lists could cause errors [#​7420](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/7420)

##### Dependency Changes

This release has no dependency changes

Previous release can be found at [v0.35.0](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.35.0)

</details>
